**1 Star – Worst Mattress Purchase Ever**

This foam mattress isνια uncomfortable from the first night—it feels like sleeping on a giant marshmallow with zero support. Within weeks, it developed deep sagging in the middle, making it impossible to get a good night’s sleep. The off-gassing smell was overwhelming and lingered for days, giving me headaches. It traps heat like an oven, so I wake up sweating every morning. The edges collapse if you even sit on them, making the bed feel half its size. For the price, I expected durability, but it’s already falling apart after just a few months. Customer service was useless when I tried to return it, ignoring my requests. Do not waste your money—this mattress is a complete disappointment.
